card.name: Ndombolo
card.tagline: Fast hip-swaying soukous offshoot that conquered Africa
card.profile: Ndombolo (or dombolo) is a Congolese (DR Congo) dance-music genre that emerged from soukous in the mid-1990s, defined by fast, hip-swaying movements over the high-energy sebene. Per Wikipedia, it features lead and backing vocals, electric guitars, drum kit and the atalaku's chants; it was pioneered by bands such as Wenge Musica and stars Koffi Olomide, JB Mpiana and Werrason. Its provocative moves drew bans in several countries even as it dominated dancefloors across central, eastern and western Africa.
card.insight: Ndombolo became continental Africa's defining dance craze of the late 1990s and 2000s and seeded styles from coupe-decale to Angolan kuduro (Wikipedia; African Music Library).
